title: catapodium halleri var. tenuiculum
intro: Catapodium halleri var. tenuiculum, commonly known as alpine oat grass, is a plant species within the grass family (Poaceae). It is a perennial grass that has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of alpine oat grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
